subject.title: feat(tools/write): add append mode for agent writes

question: Should maintainers retire this broad append branch in favor of the narrower https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102243, or keep this branch and require it to be trimmed before merge?
rationale: Both PRs implement the same model-facing append feature for the canonical data-loss issue, but this branch also contains unrelated session/gateway drift and a concrete import regression, so automation should not decide which branch carries the product/API contract.

options.title: Prefer focused replacement
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102243 as the append-mode candidate after exact-head validation, and ask for any unrelated session-admission work from this branch as a separate focused PR.

options.title: Trim this branch
options.body: Keep this PR as the candidate only if it drops unrelated formatting/gateway drift, removes duplicate wrapper surface, and fixes the Code Mode import regression before merge.

options.title: Accept broad branch risk
options.body: Land this branch after maintainer review while explicitly owning the compatibility and session-state risk from the extra surfaces.

recommendation.title: Prefer focused replacement
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102243 as the append-mode candidate after exact-head validation, and ask for any unrelated session-admission work from this branch as a separate focused PR.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available routing candidate for the agent tool API and product boundary decision from current-main history.
